per_incident.root_cause: A misconfigured 5‑second cache TTL caused rapid expirations, leading to a cache stampede and downstream DB overload.

per_incident.root_cause: A poll timeout (max.poll.interval.ms) on worker‑2 caused a rebalance storm, removing the worker from the consumer group and leading to a sudden drop in consumption rate and lag accumulation.
per_incident.verdict_explanation: Identified all core causal mechanisms (2/2 criteria groups matched).

per_incident.root_cause: The newly introduced global AUDIT_TRACE_REGISTRY dict that stores raw bytes of each uploaded file causes unbounded memory growth, leading to the OOM kill.
per_incident.verdict_explanation: Identified all core causal mechanisms (1/1 criteria groups matched).

per_incident.root_cause: The recent in‑memory check‑then‑act implementation (without locking) introduced a race condition that allowed concurrent reservations to oversell SKU‑901, producing negative inventory.
per_incident.verdict_explanation: Identified all core causal mechanisms (1/1 criteria groups matched).

per_incident.root_cause: Invalid date filters cause unhandled ValueError exceptions that prevent connection release, leaking pool connections and leading to exhaustion.
per_incident.verdict_explanation: Identified all core causal mechanisms (1/1 criteria groups matched).

per_incident.root_cause: The recent code change that raised MAX_RETRIES to 10 and set BACKOFF_BASE_SECONDS to 0.0 caused immediate, rapid retries, producing the outbound request surge and downstream overload.
per_incident.verdict_explanation: Identified all core causal mechanisms (1/1 criteria groups matched).

per_incident.root_cause: An external tax service latency spike to ~25‑30 seconds, independent of code changes, blocked all worker threads, leading to 504 gateway timeouts and 503 service‑busy responses.
per_incident.verdict_explanation: Identified all core causal mechanisms (1/1 criteria groups matched).

per_incident.root_cause: The removal of index idx_tenant_status_name caused the search queries to fall back to full sequential scans, which saturated disk I/O and produced the observed latency spikes.
